scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: The proof is symbolic from the q-matroid rank axioms; no numerical enumeration or computational certificate is used.

scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Exact threshold classification for rank-two q-matroids of ambient dimension at least three, with an application to code-induced q-matroids.
